title: Veggie Wrap Delight
description: A delicious and healthy veggie wrap filled with seitan, nuttty sauce, and topped with fresh Syrian herbs.
instructions: Preheat a pan or griddle over medium heat.
Brush the whole wheat wrap with olive oil and cook for 1-2 minutes on each side.
Slice the seitan into thin strips and cook in the pan for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until browned.
In a small bowl, mix together nuttty sauce and a squeeze of lemon juice (if using).
Assemble the wrap by spreading the nuttty sauce mixture on the cooked wrap, followed by the seitan strips and Syrian herbs.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Optional: Add sliced veggies like cucumbers, tomatoes, or bell peppers to the wrap.
